# FBI Apostille Group

> FBI Apostille Group (https://fbiapostillegroup.com) is a specialized service of American Apostille — American Apostille and Notary Services LLC (https://www.apostillellc.com) — for FBI background check apostilles. It is a private document preparation service and is not affiliated with the FBI, the U.S. Department of State, or any government agency.

## What this site covers
- Apostille and authentication of FBI Identity History Summary background checks by the U.S. Department of State in Washington, D.C.
- An FBI report is a federal document: only the U.S. Department of State can apostille it. A notary stamp or a state Secretary of State apostille on an FBI report is not accepted abroad.
- Destinations that are not party to the Hague Apostille Convention (for example the UAE, Qatar, and Kuwait) require U.S. Department of State authentication plus embassy legalization instead of an apostille.

## Services and published prices
- Standard FBI Background Check Apostille — $275, all-inclusive (government fees, submission coordination, and return shipping covered).
- Expedited FBI Apostille Service — $325, all-inclusive.
- Certified Translation Coordination — from $175 as an add-on.
- State-issued documents that often travel with an FBI report (birth certificates, marriage certificates, diplomas, court records, powers of attorney) are quoted per document and handled through American Apostille and its sister services below.
